entities.title: Check that online.ts stays identical in three games
entities.summary: src/online.ts and test/online.test.ts are copied in Rally, Shatterbelt and Hivestorm, and nothing checks the copies agree.
entities.compromise: The file is copied rather than shared, and kept identical by hand.
entities.cost: A fix made in one game and not the others would put the games' online play out of step with each other, and nothing would say so.
acceptanceCriteria: A check in CI fails when the three copies differ, or the file is shared from one place.

origin.description: The file's opening comment: the same file is in Rally, Shatterbelt and Hivestorm.

entities.title: Check that the name rules stay identical to Samosa's
entities.summary: src/name.ts must match games/dictator/src/name.ts, and nothing checks it.
entities.compromise: The rules are copied, and the comment asks to keep the two identical.
entities.cost: A name valid in one game could be refused by the other's table.
acceptanceCriteria: A check fails when the two files' rules differ, or the rules are shared from one place.
